entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say 'Returns' or 'Technical Support' to be connected to the right department.
Uh, returns, I guess?
Connecting you to a returns specialist now.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is David. How can I help you today?
Hi, yes, I need to... I think I need to send something back. I'm just so confused by the website.
I can certainly help you with that. To get started, could I get your order number, please?
Okay, hold on... it's VF-881-209-345.
Thank you. Let me pull that up... I see an order for a Pro-Series cycling jersey, delivered on December 12th. Is that the correct item?
Yes, that's the one. The jersey.
Okay. And to make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?

It's... well, it's just the wrong size. I tried it on and it's way too tight across the chest. I thought I followed the sizing chart, but I must have gotten it wrong. I just don't know what to do. Can't you just help me?
Of course, I can absolutely help. It sounds like you'd like to do an exchange for a different size. Let me just check our policy for you.
Oh, okay. I hope it's not too late.
Not at all. I've checked the purchase date, and you're well within our 90-day return window. We can definitely get this sorted for you.
Oh, thank goodness! That's such a relief. I was so worried.
No problem at all. We can process this as an exchange for the next size up. Would you like me to set that up for you now?
Yes, please! That would be wonderful. Thank you so much, David.

You're very welcome. I've just processed the exchange. You'll receive an email with a pre-paid return label in the next few minutes. Just pack up the jersey that's too tight and drop it in the mail. We'll ship out the new size right away. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
No, that's everything. You've been a great help.
Glad I could assist. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
